verdict.rationale: incident.io documents hosted public and private Status Pages, and Workflows that automatically publish to the status page when an incident is updated. A Status Page API and agent-driven updates are also documented, so the core of a status page driven by incident state is clearly evidenced. The evidence does not cover custom domains or subscriber notifications, which are two of the named elements of the story. missing for 10: custom domain support, subscriber (email/SMS) notifications, independent/hands-on corroboration
